title: Power Performance and Data Collecting
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: Power Performance and Data Collecting Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: Complete tasks required in the areas of power-performance, engine rebuilding, and blueprinting.
Perform the tasks required for employment as an automotive machinist.
Demonstrate mastery level understanding of manufacture/aftermarket specification, Shop-Key repair manual, and automotive repair procedures.

Comply with personal and environmental safety practices associated with clothing, eye protection, hand tools, power equipment, proper ventilation, and the handling, storage, and disposal of chemicals/materials in accordance with local, state, and federal safety and environmental regulation.

notes: The description refers to the 'Automotive Performance and Data Collecting Certificate of Achievement' while the heading reads 'Power Performance and Data Collecting Certificate of Achievement'; treated as the same award.

'automotive machinist' is taken from a program learning outcome ('employment as an automotive machinist'); the description also mentions 'career opportunities in independent and specialized shops', which names workplaces rather than an occupation and was not recorded as a career.
Catalog printed 'Minimum Units Required: 18' and requires a grade of C or better in all courses.
The catalog heading reads 'Summer 2026 - Summer 2027 College Catalog', consistent with the 2026-2027 catalog year.
